mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM banner WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND title LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'

SELECT banner_id::TEXT AS row_id, title, description, btn1_label, btn1_url, btn2_label, btn2_url, sort_no, (SELECT r.file_id FROM file_ref r JOIN file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = banner.banner_id AND r.file_type = 'BANNER' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS file_id FROM banner WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND (start_dt IS NULL OR start_dt = '' OR start_dt <= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND (end_dt IS NULL OR end_dt = '' OR end_dt >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY sort_no, banner_id

SELECT banner_id::TEXT AS row_id, title, description, btn1_label, btn1_url, btn2_label, btn2_url, start_dt, end_dt, sort_no, use_yn, (SELECT r.file_id FROM file_ref r JOIN file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = banner.banner_id AND r.file_type = 'BANNER' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS file_id FROM banner WHERE banner_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banner (title, description, btn1_label, btn1_url, btn2_label, btn2_url, start_dt, end_dt, sort_no, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{btn1Label}, #{btn1Url}, #{btn2Label}, #{btn2Url}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, -- 마지막(사용중) 순서+1 자동 부여 — 등록할 때마다 순서를 묻지 않는다 COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no), 0) + 1 FROM banner WHERE use_yn = 'Y')), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE banner SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, btn1_label = #{btn1Label}, btn1_url = #{btn1Url}, btn2_label = #{btn2Label}, btn2_url = #{btn2Url}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE banner_id = #{rowId}::integer

mapper.update: UPDATE banner SET sort_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE banner_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE banner SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE banner_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE banner SET sort_no = sort_no - 1, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND sort_no > (SELECT sort_no FROM banner WHERE banner_id = #{rowId}::integer)
